moves.label: Conqueror High Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a tiny active window and a heavy crescent-fist follow-through.
moves.reason: Standing crescent punch swings high and recovers into guard.

moves.label: Raoh Low Sweep
moves.description: Slow low sweep with long active slide frames that checks legs from a seated stance.
moves.reason: The sequence drops into a seated low kick and stays near shin height.

moves.label: Conqueror Leaping Clinch
moves.description: Slow jumping throw that steps in with a long capture window before Raoh resets.
moves.reason: Authored as a throw, with a forward hop and grasping upper-body poses.

moves.label: Hokuto Iron Grip
moves.description: Slow standing throw with a long active capture window and compact recovery.
moves.reason: Wide arms close into a capture stance, matching the existing throw flag.

moves.label: Seated King's Kick
moves.description: Slow mid kick that drops into a seated strike and leaves Raoh in crouch.
moves.reason: Kick travels from a low seated posture and retains the authored full-crouch end.

moves.label: Hokuto Crushing Hold
moves.description: Slow throw with a long active hold as Raoh raises his arms into a capture stance.
moves.reason: Authored throw shows repeated lifted-arm clinch/capture silhouettes.

moves.label: Conqueror Driving Sweep
moves.description: Steady low knockdown sweep with very long active travel that ends crouched.
moves.reason: Low sliding kick path and crouched finish clearly support low knockdown and FC end.

moves.label: Hokuto Power Crush
moves.description: Instant mid knockdown crush with long active force and a deliberate recovery.
moves.reason: Heavy crescent swing is already a knockdown and reads as a forceful mid blow.

moves.label: Crouch Wheel Rush
moves.description: Fast mid crouch rush with long active rolling kicks and almost no recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch sequence rolls through several mid-body kicking frames.

moves.label: Crouch Hokuto Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with long active rising pressure that flips into a pop-up.
moves.reason: Crouch entry rises into a lift and inverted finish, matching authored launch height.

moves.label: Overdrive Crescent Jab
moves.description: Quick high overdrive jab with a short active swipe and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive entry reuses the high crescent-fist jab frames.

moves.label: Conqueror Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown drive with very long active aura pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Large sustained aura sequence is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Sidestep Low Slide
moves.description: Slow low sidestep slide with long active reach that ends in full crouch.
moves.reason: Same seated low kick family, entered from sidestep and ending crouched.

moves.label: Rising Body Strike
moves.description: Fast mid rising strike with a long active shove and high recovery afterward.
moves.reason: While-standing sequence drives both arms forward at torso height.

moves.label: Ducking Crescent Jab
moves.description: Steady high ducking jab with a brief active crescent swing and moderate recovery.
moves.reason: Down-input version uses the same high crescent punch silhouette.

moves.label: Ducking Low Slide
moves.description: Slow low slide kick with long active reach that leaves Raoh crouched.
moves.reason: Low sliding kick sequence remains near the floor and ends in FC.

moves.label: Forward Low Slide
moves.description: Slow low forward slide with long active leg pressure and full-crouch finish.
moves.reason: Down-forward variant uses the seated low slide and authored FC end.

moves.label: Forward Crescent Fist
moves.description: Slow mid forward fist with a brief active crescent swing and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward-input swing hits through the body line rather than low.

moves.label: Advancing Low Slide
moves.description: Slow low advancing slide with long active reach that finishes in crouch.
moves.reason: Forward kick command shares the low slide frames and full-crouch end.

moves.label: Hokuto Crescent Fist
moves.description: Quick high quarter-circle fist with a short active crescent arc and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle punch uses the high crescent swing, suitable for a Hokuto-flavored name.

moves.label: Hokuto Low Slide
moves.description: Slow low quarter-circle slide with long active reach that ends in full crouch.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick is the same low seated slide family with FC end.
